title: Scene Play Elements Ui Parity With Board
description: Align scene play styling with board play: import elements react globals.css tailwind sources; LevelProvider window shell, getLevelBgClass window wrapper, useElementsSurfaceChrome, footer theme/device/expertise like board.
summary: Scene play now pulls design tokens like board play: globals.css imports ../../react/globals.css with matching @source paths. ScenePlayApp uses LevelProvider level=window, outer h-screen shell with getLevelBgClass("window"), UI with useElementsSurfaceChrome mobile bridge and footer with Theme/Device/Expertise selects (same localStorage keys as board play for dev parity). Relocate toolbar uses ToolbarItem asChild around Button like board.
